description: How TmInlineDiff places the changes inside the text: Inline flows them with their context (the presentation the component always had), Stacked gives each hunk its own row so the deletion and the insertion of a change read one below the other - the presentation for a one-hunk proposal of a whole value. The layout is about the user interface only - both layouts show exactly the same hunks and the same TextDiffResult.Apply output, and every decision surface keeps working.
